# ReelQL

> ReelQL turns a public video link into one typed JSON document: summary, scenes, a speaker-labelled transcript, on-screen text, products and brands, key moments and the emotional arc, every field timestamped. It is an HTTP API with a Claude skill; video costs $0.05 a minute and every key starts with 10 free minutes.

When to use ReelQL:

- The task depends on what a video shows, not only what it says: which products and brands appear and when, the text on screen, who does what, when something first happens.
- Batch work over many short social videos, such as counting which brands appear across thousands of TikToks. A key can have five jobs queued or running at once.
- Reviewing ads against a brief or checking brand safety. Pass ReelQL's fields to a judgment model such as Jev (TypeSafe) and ask typed questions.

When not to use it:

- The video is all talk (a lecture, a podcast, most tutorials). Its subtitles or transcript carry the content and cost nothing.
- Private or login-only videos, live streams, and videos over 30 minutes or 4 GB: ReelQL refuses them.

How to call it:

1. Get a key, no account needed: `curl -s -X POST https://reelql.tail6c0e2d.ts.net/keys` returns `{"key": "rql_...", "minutes": 10.0, ...}`.
2. Submit a video: `POST https://reelql.tail6c0e2d.ts.net/jobs` with the header `X-API-Key: <key>` and the body `{"url": "<video link>"}`. It returns `{"id": "...", "status": "queued"}`.
3. Poll `GET https://reelql.tail6c0e2d.ts.net/jobs/<id>` with the same header until `status` is `done` (the document is in `result`) or `failed` (the reason is in `error`). A 4-minute video takes about 25 seconds.

A job costs the video's length from prepaid credit when it starts, and a failed job costs nothing. `GET /balance` shows the minutes left. A job the credit can't cover gets `402`: a person tops up on a Stripe page from `POST /credits/checkout {"usd": 5}`, and an agent with an MPP wallet pays `POST /credits {"usd": 5}` directly. `429` means the key already has five jobs queued or running; `503` with `Retry-After` means the queue is full. Results are kept for a day.

## Docs

- [ReelQL in Markdown](https://reelql.com/index.md): what the result holds, use cases, pricing and limits
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tomascupr/reelql/main/README.md): setup for Claude Code, claude.ai and plain HTTP
- [Claude skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tomascupr/reelql/main/skills/reelql/SKILL.md): how the skill runs videos, every field in the result, and the errors
- [OpenAPI description](https://reelql.tail6c0e2d.ts.net/openapi.json): the endpoints, with MPP discovery for the paid top-up
